root_cause: Powerhouse had strong but partially separate revenue capabilities (SEO, problem radar, scans, workshop handoff, relationships, triggers, LinkedIn, autonomous email, content, forecasts and outcome learning). The missing layer was one cross-domain commercial orchestrator that treats every signal as part of the same revenue graph and selects the next growth play from shared evidence.
decision: Create Growth Swarm as a derived intelligence and orchestration layer over canonical Powerhouse data, not a parallel CRM. Register 20 growth plays, combine relationship/trigger/dark-funnel/scan/risk/value evidence into one account score, materialize pre-contact dossiers, feed content/referral actions, expose privacy-safe calculators/benchmarks, and run inside the existing commercial scheduler before social/private execution.
prevention: Never create a separate CRM or isolated growth stack for a new growth hack; project it into the canonical Growth Swarm and outcome lineage.
A weak signal, public post, like, visit or benchmark is never independently buying intent.
Public benchmarks require a privacy floor and may not expose named prospects or private relationship information.
Financial impact and M&A risk remain estimates/hypotheses until evidence upgrades them.
Every play must have an evidence trigger, action, channel, hard gates and terminal revenue metric.
Do not optimize on activity volume when reply, meeting, scan, order and realized revenue are available.
